extracted.name: Date & peanut butter dip
extracted.description: Try our date and peanut butter dip for a healthy snack. This sweet dip works really well with crisp veg, and you could use coconut yogurt to make it vegan
ingredient_lines: 1-2 sticks celery cut into shorter, thinner lengths
1 green pepper deseeded and cut into strips
instruction_lines: Mash the peanut butter and dates together using a fork, then stir in the yogurt. Divide between two small bowls, or pots with lids for packing into lunchboxes. Will keep covered and chilled for up to three days. Serve with the vegetables for dipping.
